title: Police cleared in cyclist's death
article: _LONDON_, Ont. - Two city _police_ officers have been cleared in the death of a bicyclist who died after he was pulled over for not having a bike light.
The officers didn't commit a criminal offence in the arrest of 52- year-old _Larry_ _Campbell_ on July 17, Ontario's _police_ watchdog agency, the Special Investigation Unit, said.
The SIU's written statement was released Tuesday.
The SIU concluded _police_ exercised proper methods when "putting Mr. _Campbell_ on the ground."
_Campbell_ was pulled over by _police_ about 1 a.m. July 17 for a Highway Traffic Act infraction.
